issues.description: In the template for Exercise 4 (Lights Out), the template sets self.number_of_bits_classical_register to the string "0" instead of an integer. The ClassicalRegister constructor expects an integer number of bits; using a string is a type error and will raise an exception when students try to construct the circuit or run the template. The problem statement and the reference solution both treat this value as an integer (the solution uses 4). This mismatch is an unintentional structural bug in the template that will prevent students from instantiating the circuit until they correct the type.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the template to assign an integer (e.g., 0 as a placeholder) to self.number_of_bits_classical_register rather than a string. For example: self.number_of_bits_classical_register = 0. Optionally, update the inline comment to remind students to set this to the correct integer number of classical bits (the reference solution uses 4).
